202.description: the account is locked and its deletion is queued

400.description: invalid request. An email that does not match the account returns {"error":"confirmation_mismatch"}; other invalid input, such as a missing email or reason, has an empty body.

404.description: user not found or already deleted

409.description: the target is an administrator (admin_account) or its deletion is already filed (account_deletion_in_progress)
